summary: Owned units s0267–s0288 contain one explicit age (七八歲時) and two source-date labels (太元中, 魏時), and no birth or death statements. The age is correctly kept as sui and not turned into a birth year; the childhood, Huan Wen fan, Xin'an marriage, and Gu Piqiang garden episodes are rightly left without Western years. 魏時 converts to the conventional Cao Wei span AD 220–265 for Wei Dan’s Lingyun-Hall anecdote (Xianzhi denies the story in the same passage; the claimed setting remains Wei). 太元 is Eastern Jin Xiaowu’s era, conventionally AD 376–396, not Sun Quan’s homonymous Wu era. That full-era window is not a justified uncertainty band for Xie An’s or Wang Xianzhi’s own Taiyuan events: the same chapter continues 及安薨…未幾…俄而卒於官, and Jinshu 9 dates 衛將軍、太保謝安薨 to 太元十年八月, whose conventional Western year is AD 385. claim-667, claim-674, claim-716, hints-p089, and person p089 therefore treat activity throughout Taiyuan as if both men could still act in AD 396. The on-or-before-385 hosting hint is consistent with Xie An’s death; empty hints for p090–p093 match the undated owned episodes.

findings.problem: Xie An’s 太元中 Taiji Hall request and the first active hint use westernInterval/end AD 396, the last conventional year of Xiaowu’s Taiyuan era. Xie An died in 太元十年八月 (conventional AD 385). The same chapter later says 及安薨. End 396 is therefore not uncertainty about his own event; it is the unused remainder of the era after his death. The hosting hint on or before 385 already contradicts that endpoint.
findings.action: On claim-674 and claim-716 keep subject, predicate, 太元中, and the plaque-request fields. Replace the AD 396 end with a death-bounded close: interval end 385 or westernBounds onOrAfter 376 and onOrBefore 385 (the request can still fall in 376 and in 385). Do not invent a second exact year, and do not collapse 太元中 to 太元三年/378 because Jinshu 9 has 作新宮 that year. Rewrite hints-p089 so any Taiyuan activity hint is bounded by 385, and keep the supported on-or-before-385 hosting hint.

findings.problem: Wang Xianzhi’s 太元中 attestation is given westernInterval end AD 396. After the owned plaque and 尋除 offices, the same chapter has 及安薨 then 未幾，獻之遇疾 and 俄而卒於官. Xie An’s death is 太元十年/AD 385, so Xianzhi’s own Taiyuan events cannot run to the era’s last year.
